role: CI gate (make lint-budget; ci.yml lint-and-budgets) that the SwiftLint JSON report's violation count does not exceed .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd. exit 66 if budget missing, 65 if empty. Runs `swiftlint lint --reporter json` into the report (if swiftlint is absent or exits non-zero on error-severity violations, set -e aborts here). Python prints count/budget and top-10 rules and exits 1 if count > int(float(budget)). Because `summary="$(python3 ...)"` runs under set -e, an over-budget result aborts the script at the assignment: the captured summary (count and top rules) is never echoed, so the failing run prints nothing about why. Passing run echoes the summary and appends to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.
